info.prompt: A Neo-Gothic Cyberpunk dice tray where a {7th custom die|glowing bio-mechanical artifact} assembles itself from fractured shards, each face snapping into place with {Neon Cyan|Electric Magenta} circuitry pulses, surrounded by skeletal gold filigree and void black neural latticework that hums with rhythmic oscilloscope waves, all under a cinematic hacker-terminal overlay.
